about_the_game:
THE DOWNLOAD LINK FOR THE DEMO IS ABOVE!

Welcome to Sixth Force, a family-friendly co-op action-adventure where story and gameplay blend seamlessly. Step into the roles of Michael, a workaholic programmer, and his son Thomas, a rebellious budding graffiti artist. Both unexpectedly find themselves trapped in a simulation alongside their quirky AI companion, KIKI, and bound by the mysterious Sixth Force. Together, you’ll navigate their evolving relationship, master unique abilities, and tackle the challenges of a surreal digital world.
Sixth Force is built around cooperation — play together in local co-op or online via Steam Remote Play — either way, this journey is meant to be shared.

🪢 The Bond Core Mechanic

The glowing link between characters starts short and a bit frustrating — just like real-life tension. But as their bond deepens, it grows stronger and unlocks unique co-op powers.

🧠 Telekinesis & World Interaction

Move objects, solve puzzles, and reshape the world. As trust builds, you’ll unlock the power to create, destroy, and transform your surroundings together.

🌟 The Sixth Force in Action

At full strength, the bond lets you make the intangible real — light becomes platforms, thoughts shape the world, and yes… you can fly.

🌌 Dreamlike Simulations

Explore surreal digital worlds built from the characters’ talents, dreams, and memories — a journey through their inner lives, one level at a time. 

🤝 Family-friendly fun for everyone

Whether you’re a veteran player or new to co-op games, Sixth Force offers challenges and playful problem-solving for all ages, enjoyable even for inexperienced players.

🛷 Fooling Around

And there’s always time for fun, trolling, and messing with each other! Who found the combo? Who’ll win the tug-of-war with the bond? Who’ll slide down the plastic slide first?

IMPORTANT NOTES

• Two controllers required – Sixth Force is designed as a co-op-only experience. No single-player mode available.

• Shared-screen local & online co-op – Whether you’re playing side by side or via Steam Remote Play, the shared-screen setup keeps both players fully in sync and in the action.

• Demo-preview of the full game  - Play through the first two levels and get a taste of the story, mechanics, and atmosphere of Sixth Force.

Wishlist and follow Sixth Force and be the first to try the full adventure upon release!
